title: A deploy that renames the CLI entry leaves every launcher working
description: A deploy publishes a release whose bin/graphyard.mjs is a shim importing a renamed entry. The install launcher, the watch checkout's launcher and deploy/build's launcher all still run status and master status, and the loop service's ExecStart starts the release's master run: no file a launcher imports is missing.

steps.name: deploy a release with a renamed CLI entry, then run every launcher and the loop service's start
